new.description: New suite pinning the one-version invariant across the two homes a cut bumps together. Reads `sdk/package.json` the way `src/install.rs:103` already does (`include_str!`), compares its `version` against `temper::VERSION` (`src/lib.rs:18`, `env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`), then compares every `optionalDependencies` pin (`@dtmd/temper-linux-x64`, `@dtmd/temper-win32-x64`) against the same string. Non-vacuity: the manifest must parse and the pins map must be present and non-empty before any comparison runs, so an emptied or renamed map fails rather than passing over nothing. Failure messages name both homes, the offending key, and the release rule's bump-every-home step.

edit.description: Declare `mod version_parity;` in the alphabetical module list — `every_suite_beside_this_file_is_declared_here` refuses a suite that compiles and runs nothing.

summary: Gate the one-version invariant: a test pins the engine's own version to sdk/package.json's and to every engine pin the SDK declares.

tests.asserts: sdk/package.json's `version` equals `temper::VERSION`; every `optionalDependencies` pin equals it; the pins map is non-empty.

acceptance: `cargo test` green with `version_parity` declared in `tests/it/main.rs`, and the suite goes red when either version home moves without the other.
notes: The spec states the invariant; nothing enforces it. Only the engine half is gated today — a Cargo bump without a lock re-emit fails `emit --frozen`, while an SDK-only bump passes everything. `src/install.rs` embeds sdk/package.json's version for the range `install` writes, so a skew mis-scaffolds adopters. Excluded on purpose: sdk/package-lock.json, which trails the tag by design (release rule step 9) and is already gated by `npm --prefix sdk ci`. scoped at 91f4fa2d
